OBSERVED_PEAK_USAGE.scw_peak_aggregate_gb: NOT_MEASURED (workers not spawned due to commit pressure)

COOK_MEMORY_BUDGET_DERIVATION.MEMORY_MAX_VIRTUAL_JUSTIFICATION: Derived from system commit limit (59.5 GB) minus OS/background reserve (7 GB) = 52.5 GB available. UE4Editor peak virtual 12.5 GB + SCW estimated max 8.0 GB = 20.5 GB peak. With 10 GB safety margin = 30.5 GB limit. Setting MemoryMaxUsedVirtual=30500 MiB provides commit throttling while allowing headroom for peak usage. This is well below the 48000 MiB previously proposed.
COOK_MEMORY_BUDGET_DERIVATION.MEMORY_MAX_PHYSICAL_JUSTIFICATION: UE4Editor peak working set 4.6 GB. SCW workers typically use 1-2 GB working set each. With 4 workers: 4.6 + 8 = 12.6 GB. Current MemoryMaxUsedPhysical=16384 MiB (16 GB) provides adequate headroom. No change needed.
COOK_MEMORY_BUDGET_DERIVATION.NOTE: MemoryMaxUsedVirtual=30500 enables commit throttling. If cook still hits limit, reduce SCW count via DevOptions.Shaders.NumUnusedShaderCompilingThreads before lowering this threshold.
